bottleneck.summary: Small coherent gain +.0301…+.0688 lambda and Tc+.403 K is not a calibrated physical significance claim. Path0/Gammaopt+, low coarse residual and fine force .0375/stress .364 GPa support only finite-source local basin. Geoopt BFGS failure is retained. Tc radioactivity, heavy-Re scalar/SOC differential and weak benefit are material-specific refinement risks.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Source coarse force 6.81342394061318e-05 eV/Å, pressure 0.0 GPa; fine force 0.037504684913858284 eV/Å, pressure -0.191 GPa. Actual full stress, Γ interval, finite path and q observations are retained in the complete review; no whole-BZ/global-stability claim.

Direct support for approximately 300 K at ambient pressure

proposed_contribution.intervention: Re-to-Tc ordered role change in Ti2NbX. coupled chemistry/site-role/volume/mass construction, not isolated geometry or inferred W/n
proposed_contribution.next_action: Resolve Tc/Re site mode and Coulomb/SOC sensitivity. Favorable: small paired role gain remains under justified corrections; adverse: sign reversal; ambiguous: uncertainty exceeds response. Do not award high n from electron counting.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
